name: Paribu Ticker
author: publisherparibu

sections.description:
Paribu Ticker displays current cryptocurrency prices on your WordPress site using the public market-data API of the Paribu exchange. It can be used via shortcode, the classic widget, or a PHP template function.

Features:

  • Single coin card, multi-coin table, and compact ticker-bar layouts
  • Automatic price refresh (AJAX-based, no page reload)
  • Turkish and English language support
  • Responsive design — works on desktop and mobile
  • Caching via the WordPress Transients API (bounded upstream requests)
  • Graceful degradation: serves the last known prices if the API is briefly unavailable
  • Shortcode, classic widget, and PHP template function support

Official plugin:
Paribu Ticker is developed and maintained by Paribu. Cryptocurrency price data is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice.

External services

This plugin connects to one external service: the Paribu public market-data API, in order to retrieve current cryptocurrency prices for display.

  • What it is / what it is used for: A read-only public endpoint that returns market ticker data (last price, 24h change, high/low, volume) for the markets listed on the Paribu exchange. The plugin uses it to render the prices shown by the shortcodes, widget, and template function.
  • What data is sent and when: The plugin sends an outbound HTTP GET request from your server to https://api.paribu.com/market/ticker. No personal data and no site-visitor data are transmitted — the request contains only a standard User-Agent identifying the plugin and your WordPress version. Requests are made when ticker data is rendered and the local cache has expired (bounded to roughly one request per configured cache window, regardless of visitor count).
  • Service provider: Paribu — Terms of Use — Privacy Policy

By using this plugin you acknowledge that price data is fetched from this external service and is subject to Paribu’s terms and availability.

Configuration

The settings page is located under Settings > Paribu Ticker.

Available settings:

  • Default display mode (single card / table / ticker)
  • Default market pair (e.g. btc_tl)
  • Default market list (e.g. btc_tl,eth_tl,usdt_tl)
  • Auto refresh (on/off)
  • Refresh interval (30–300 seconds)
  • Cache duration (30–300 seconds)
  • Language mode (auto / Turkish / English)
  • Show/hide disclaimer
  • Show/hide attribution

Shortcode Usage

Single Price Card

[paribu_price]

Attributes:

  • pair — Market symbol, e.g. btc_tl (default: the default pair from settings)
  • show_change — yes or no (default: yes)
  • show_low_high — yes or no (default: yes)
  • show_volume — yes or no (default: no)
  • layout — card (default: card)

Example:
[paribu_price pair=”eth_tl” show_change=”yes” show_low_high=”yes” show_volume=”yes”]

Multiple Price Table / Ticker

[paribu_prices]

Attributes:

  • pairs — Comma-separated market symbols, e.g. btc_tl,eth_tl,usdt_tl (default: the default list from settings)
  • layout — table or ticker (default: table)
  • columns — Comma-separated columns: pair,last,percentage,change,low,high,volume (default: all)
  • limit — Maximum number of rows (default: unlimited)
  • show_header — yes or no (default: yes)

Examples:
[paribu_prices pairs=”btc_tl,eth_tl,usdt_tl” layout=”table”]
[paribu_prices pairs=”btc_tl,eth_tl,usdt_tl,avax_tl” layout=”ticker”]
[paribu_prices pairs=”btc_tl,eth_tl” layout=”table” columns=”pair,last,percentage” limit=”5″]

PHP Template Function

For direct use in theme templates:

<?php
if ( function_exists( 'paribu_ticker_render' ) ) {
    paribu_ticker_render( array(
        'pair'   => 'btc_tl',
        'layout' => 'card',
    ) );
}
?>

Multiple price table:

<?php
if ( function_exists( 'paribu_ticker_render' ) ) {
    paribu_ticker_render( array(
        'pairs'  => 'btc_tl,eth_tl,usdt_tl',
        'layout' => 'table',
    ) );
}
?>
sections.installation:
1. Upload the paribu-ticker folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in the WordPress admin.
  3. Configure the plugin under Settings > Paribu Ticker.
  4. Display prices in a post or page using a shortcode.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Paribu account for this plugin?

No. The plugin uses Paribu’s public market-data API. No account or API key is required.

How often are prices updated?

Prices refresh automatically at the interval you configure (default: 60 seconds). The cache duration is configurable on the same settings page. Upstream API calls are bounded to roughly one per cache window regardless of how many visitors are viewing the page.

Which cryptocurrencies are supported?

All market pairs listed on the Paribu exchange are supported. Symbols returned by the API are available automatically.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin caches API responses using the WordPress Transients API, so a new API call is not made on every page load. Plugin assets are only loaded on pages that actually display a ticker.

What happens if the Paribu API does not respond?

Visitors are shown the last known prices when available, or a generic “Price data is temporarily unavailable.” message otherwise. Technical error details are written only to the admin debug log.

Is this an official Paribu product?

Yes. Paribu Ticker is developed and maintained by Paribu.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Single coin card, multi-coin table, and compact ticker-bar layouts.
  • Automatic price refresh via a public REST endpoint serving cached data — upstream API calls are bounded per cache window, with stampede protection and a last-known-data fallback.
  • Caching via the WordPress Transients API.
  • Turkish and English language support.
  • Admin settings page, classic widget, and PHP template function.
  • Frontend assets are loaded only on pages that render a ticker.
  • Multisite-aware uninstall.
